## Definition of Done

- [ ] `make verify` passes locally (CI runs the same targets).
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` updated, or not user-visible.
- [ ] Docs updated in this PR, or none describe this.
- [ ] ADR added in `docs/adr/`, or nothing expensive to reverse.
- [ ] Schema change has a migration note, or the snapshot contract is unchanged.
- [ ] UI change keeps VoiceOver labels, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion working, or no UI changed.
- [ ] No new host, SDK, tracking or data source; or its threat-model note and terms snapshot are included.
- [ ] Quality characteristic served (ISO 25010): <!-- e.g. functional suitability, security, interaction capability -->
